name: vca_call_failed_@ENV@
description: venue-call-agent (@SERVICE@): a call ended badly or could not start. One count per log line; the token label says which line. Source lines: ops/monitoring/README.md.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="@SERVICE@" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stderr") AND (textPayload=~"^(stream|call-supervisor|live-call) \S+ (call_failed|handler_failed|internal_error|seam_unavailable|session_left_line_up|exited_without_reason|cascade_unavailable|call_ended_record_failed|call_ended_unrecorded)( |$)" OR textPayload:"ALERT_STOP_CALLING_UNRECORDED")

labels.description: The event word from the log line, e.g. call_failed or internal_error.
